title: Introducing Claude for Manufacturing
summary: Claude for Manufacturing is a plugin with 17 skills and four connectors (Autodesk Fusion, Infor, Microsoft 365, and Oracle NetSuite) that drafts quotes, quality reports, and supplier requests from a manufacturer's own records. Its skills cover failed-inspection investigation, breakdown diagnosis, sourcing, design comparison, and production reporting, and the Infor plugin can make approved changes. It is available on Team and Enterprise plans, humans approve all work, and it does not operate equipment.

title: Your apps can now open in Claude, and Claude can work in them
summary: Partner apps can now embed directly in Claude, built on interactive connectors and MCP Apps, an open extension in public preview. Users can open a tool beside chat or full screen, where Claude edits the open page, row, or file with user approval, and tools can be pinned to the sidebar and + menu to open without a prompt. Launch partners include Asana, Canva, Dropbox, monday.com, Smartsheet, Vercel, and Webflow, with examples from Adobe, Atlassian, Box, HubSpot, and Notion, so work stays in familiar tools.

title: Operate Claude Managed Agents inside your security perimeter
summary: Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents are in private beta, letting organizations run the full service, including the harness, sandboxes, credentials, and session history, in their own cloud or on-prem rather than only the sandbox. Teams choose whether model requests go to Anthropic, a cloud provider, or their own gateway, with reasoning separated from code execution, credentials kept out of the sandbox, an allowed-host network list, and OpenTelemetry export of every step. This keeps data in the organization's environment for unattended agents, and ZDR applies to model requests.

title: Linked billing on the Claude Platform
summary: Linked billing on the Claude Platform is in beta and lets third-party platforms bill Claude API usage to a customer's own Claude Platform org. Customers link platforms through a hosted flow, approve each one, set monthly spend limits, view spend in Console, and unlink at any time, while platforms skip building metering and invoicing and can choose per request who pays. No API keys change hands, but requests run in the platform's org, so customer-org IP allowlists, encryption keys, and retention settings do not apply.

title: Introducing Claude Meetings
summary: Claude Meetings is a beta in which Claude joins Google Meet video calls as a visible participant on Team and Enterprise plans. Claude can answer questions by voice or chat, build docs and whiteboards live, and write notes and action items, with each meeting saved as a claude.ai page containing notes, transcript, and built artifacts. It stays out of calls with outside guests unless an admin allows it, stores transcripts and summaries rather than audio, and is not available for ZDR, HIPAA-ready, or CMEK orgs during beta.

title: The Claude Tag guide for startups
summary: This guide covers Claude Tag (beta), a Slack-based tool for Team and Enterprise where teams @mention Claude, connect tools, and assign tasks. It profiles eight startups using it for on-call triage, Slack-to-draft-PR, company Q&A, self-serve data, and recurring reports, with results such as Campfire going from mention to PR in 21 minutes and NavigateAI merging 134 PRs. Guardrails include people reviewing and merging draft PRs, admin connector bundles, per-channel settings, and spend limits.
